current_concerns.primary_problems: Long-term restriction of food intake and persistent calorie counting, beginning around age 18. The concerns are most noticeable in interpersonal relationships: avoids eating with others, plans extensively in advance, sometimes for several days, for a single meal. This also causes distraction at work. Weight has partially restored over the past year, but thoughts about food and eating remain persistent.
current_concerns.goals: Be able to eat a meal with friends without planning it several days in advance; spend less time thinking about food throughout the day and gradually let go of thoughts that disrupt daily life; reduce persistent preoccupation with and checking of body shape. Patient reports that weight has partially restored over the past six months to one year.
